photos.title: File:2017 One57 base from Seventh Avenue.jpg
photos.author: Beyond My Ken
photos.description: One57 , formerly known as Carnegie 57 is a residential skyscraper located at 157 West 57th Street , between Sixth and Seventh Avenues, in the Midtown Manhattan neighborhood of New York City . It was built from 2009-14 and was designed by the French architect Christian de Portzamparc, with interiors by Thomas Juul-Hansen.
